strategy.text:
(1) ATTACK? — Milotic will likely attack or status. Candidates: Scald (I resist), Surf, Ice Beam, or a status move (Toxic/Recover). Since I'm switching, none threaten me much — worst realistic is Hydro Pump 33-39% to Rotom-W with +SpA investment. Confidence medium; its set is unrevealed.
(2) SWITCH? — Might Recover off any chip, or stay and attack.
(3) THEIR READ OF ME — It saw Oranguru as an offensive Focus Blast user and switched Beartic out only by fainting; it now faces Oranguru and will likely try to wall/chip it (Recover + Toxic stall).
(4) MY OPTIONS & THE COST OF SWITCHING — Switching to Rotom-Wash forfeits this turn and Rotom eats Milotic's move (17-28%, up to ~39% Hydro Pump), but Rotom resists Water and gains the good matchup: Volt Switch is SE STAB ~41-49% to force Milotic out/pivot. Staying with Oranguru Psychic only chips 23-28% vs a 125-SpD Recover wall — futile stall. The switch clearly gains a kill-forcing threat. Steadier than Oranguru-attacking because it converts a losing stall matchup into pressure.
(5) MOST LIKELY ACTION + RESPONSE — Milotic uses Scald/Surf (~25-32% to Rotom-W). My response next turn: Volt Switch to chunk and pivot. Falsifier: if Milotic uses a boosting/phazing move or reveals a coverage I didn't expect, reassess.
(6) ACTION SEQUENCE — Switch to Rotom-Wash, eat Scald/Surf (→ ~70-80%), then Volt Switch next turn dealing 41-49% while pivoting out.

strategy.text:
(1) ATTACK? Milotic is a special wall; it will likely attack (Scald 25-30% to Oranguru, or Ice Beam 19-22%) or use Toxic/Recover. Its offense is weak, so it may also set up or Toxic. Confident it targets Oranguru if I stay — Psychic only does 23-28% and it Recovers it back, a losing exchange.
(2) SWITCH? Milotic just came in full HP; unlikely to switch immediately.
(3) THEIR READ: sees only Oranguru (Normal/Psychic). Will expect me to attack or stay; may try Toxic.
(4) MY OPTIONS: Staying with Psychic = Oranguru ends 33-44%, Milotic only 23-28% and Recovers → pure loss to a Recover wall. Switching to Jirachi = it takes only 26-31% from Scald, 9-11% from Ice Beam, and is IMMUNE to Toxic (Steel). Cost: forfeit this turn, Jirachi eats one hit (survives comfortably with Leftovers). Gain: Jirachi hard-walls Milotic and enables Stealth Rock/Thunder Wave/U-turn progress. Steadier and higher-value than grinding with Oranguru. No entry hazards on my side.
(5) MOST LIKELY ACTION: Milotic uses Scald or Toxic. My reply: switch Jirachi in; it survives. Falsifier: if it uses Hydro Pump (35-42%), Jirachi still survives.
(6) SEQUENCE: T3 I switch Jirachi (eats ~26-31%). T4 Jirachi faces Milotic: I can set Stealth Rock or Thunder Wave, or Iron Head. Milotic can't break Jirachi quickly.
